name: PocketMaps
tagline: A completely opensource map viewer with (offline) navigation system.
blurb: Maps can be easily downloaded with this app.
description:
Maps can be easily downloaded with this app.
Thus, a complete offline navigation is possible.

Through the so-called 'geocoding' places can be searched.
* The search requires an internet connection.
* A limited offline search is also available.

With the sport tracking feature, routes can be recorded to graph data such as speeds.

install.label: F-Droid
install.note: Adds F-Droid as an update source, so you keep getting updates.
